protocol.task: predict x[t+1] at t=0,1,2 from iid N(0,1) sequences of length 4
protocol.fit: least squares on 384 training targets with intercept; 2 trainable scalars; no test selection
protocol.metric: MSE per target, retain per-sequence MSE
protocol.baseline: constant zero, population optimal for independent future
protocol.hand_demo: 6 parameters; eta=0.1; 2 simultaneous SGD updates, full third forward; half-MSE over 4 targets
protocol.negative_result_policy: retain all seeds and conditions; no seed replacement or favorable-only report
protocol.interpretation: unmasked held-out score invalid for causal forecasting
protocol.resource: CPU float64 one thread; no peak-memory or throughput claim
